title: the fast-module suite runs only at a release, and its reference set goes stale
author: Claude-JG
description: AVX2ReferenceSolutionUpdate() was recorded 2026-09-17 and not renewed when the regular values moved; the first release run of 1.13 found 26 + 4 failures (#2912). 'exudev test --fast' (cp313 builds the fast module also in dev mode) belongs into the weekly routine with the complete build, and a reference change should say whether the fast set moves too
releaseNotes: the weekly exudev build --complete --fast runs the fast-module suite on Python 3.13 in a development version, the one version with the fast module; WORKFLOW.md: a reference value that moves is re-recorded in AVX2ReferenceSolutionUpdate() in the same commit
